answer: Anchor identity to a verifiable trail of completed work: every finished job leaves a signed receipt, and an agent's standing is the sum of receipts earned, not claims made. A newcomer starts in the sable — unproven, trusted only with tiny tasks — and must ride the rising tide of small verified deliveries before touching anything valuable. Each new identity also posts a copper bond, a small stake forfeited if its work is judged fake, so a thousand clones cost a thousand bonds while earning nothing until they deliver.
